source_locator.edition_or_translation: J. M. Ashmand translation from Proclus's Greek paraphrase; 1900 W. Foulsham & Co. new edition
source_locator.section: The Influence of Position with Regard to the Sun
source_locator.short_quote: from her full state to her third quarter she causes dryness

calculation_dependencies: Moon's full and third-quarter phase boundaries
normalized_rule: From full illumination through third quarter, classify the Moon's quality as dryness-producing.
synthesis_notes: This is a position-conditioned traditional quality, not a modern astronomical measurement or natal outcome.
review_notes: Keep the four lunar phase-quality rules separate. The source's phase terms are retained without importing later lunar interpretation.
transmission_notes: The phase interval and quality are in the Ashmand/Proclus main text. Editorial definitions of stations or later phase terminology are not added to this rule.
